headline: Pensions: New Framework for Occupational Insurance – Supplementary Savings in the Spotlight
summary: A Greek bill on occupational insurance sets out a new framework for supplementary savings. Officials cite benefits for insured persons, businesses and the national economy.
why: Supplementary pension savings channel long-term capital into domestic markets and affect the funding of private pension providers.
